run_hydra_training_entry_point: run the Hydra-configured training script that initializes MyModel and saves a checkpoint
create_model_with_random_seed: create a MyModel instance using a random seed from the Hydra config
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint file to the configured checkpoint path directory
configure_hydra_with_ray_launcher: configure Hydra to use the custom Ray AWS launcher for remote training jobs
review_train_main_function: review the main function that orchestrates model initialization and checkpoint saving via Hydra config
